$comment: Large test data that cannot live in git. See docs/design/test_data.md.
Every entry needs a sha256 that was computed from the actual file, never copied from a
web page. 'ciEligible' is false until someone has read the licence and is willing to
say the data may be downloaded by unattended CI; --ci-only skips those entries rather
than leaving the question to whoever next reads a workflow file.
'citation' records an attribution the licence asks for. Public domain is not the same
as no obligation: a dataset may be freely usable and still ask to be cited, which
matters as soon as results computed from it are published.

datasets.name: redwood_rgbd_sample
datasets.description: Five synchronised colour/depth frames from the Redwood indoor dataset, with PrimeSense intrinsics, odometry and a trajectory. Small enough for CI; the smallest input that exercises a full RGB-D sequence.
datasets.licenseNote: Verified 2026-10-14, quoting the page: 'The entire dataset, including both RGB-D scans and reconstructed models, is in the public domain. Any part of the dataset can be used for any purpose with proper attribution.' Open3D's own source does not state which Redwood dataset the five-frame sample is drawn from, so the attribution below follows the maintainer's determination.
datasets.citation: Jaesik Park, Qian-Yi Zhou and Vladlen Koltun, "Colored Point Cloud Registration Revisited", ICCV 2017.

datasets.name: texture_consolidation_vase
datasets.description: TextureConsolidation's example data: a texture-atlased vase mesh (5,067 vertices, 9,998 faces, binary PLY with per-face texcoords), nine photographs at 1002 x 1336 and their pinhole cameras (cameras.json, OpenCV convention). Prepared by the authors: photos downsampled by 2, atlas regenerated with xatlas, mesh and cameras scaled to surface area 5. The end-to-end fixture for Transfer Color from Visible Rasters to Texture (Texture Consolidation).
datasets.licenseNote: The archive's README says the vase model and photographs are courtesy of Paolo Cignoni and Marco Callieri, Visual Computing Laboratory, ISTI-CNR, and states no licence. Recorded 2026-10-28; the owners are to state the terms, which decide ciEligible.
datasets.citation: Hongyi Liu, Yifan Wang, Vladimir G. Kim and Misha Kazhdan, "Texture Consolidation of Generated Multi-View Renderings", arXiv 2610.36098, 2026.
